children: Invivyd appointed Marc Elia as Chief Executive Officer and added Ian Sheffield to its Board of Directors, both effective August 30, 2026.
Chief Executive Officer; Chairman of the Board (continuing)
Director; member of Compensation Committee; member of Audit Committee
Board appointment to serve as principal executive officer; role previously held by William Duke, Jr.
Board expanded from six to seven directors to fill resulting vacancy
Replaced William Duke, Jr. as principal executive officer; William Duke, Jr. remains principal financial and accounting officer
Age 50; Board member since June 2022; founder & CIO of M28 Capital Management since Sept 2019; former partner at Bridger Capital; prior biotech roles; B.A. Economics, Carleton College.
Term expires at 2027 annual meeting; will receive standard non-employee director compensation and retainers for Audit and Compensation Committees.
Replaced as Chair of Nominating & Corporate Governance Committee by Ajay Royan
Appointed to Compensation Committee and to replace Marc Elia on the Audit Committee
